description: Does a non-resident founder need an ITIN? Explains when an ITIN is required (filing a US tax return, US-source income, treaty benefits, bank/marketplace requests) and when it is not (you never need one just to form an LLC or get an EIN). Includes Epics Deals' $299 ITIN application service and typical IRS processing time.
